title: Concept: Passport number in a response
description: A passport number field holding a full document number in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The passport is the strongest identity document a customer holds, and its number with the name and date of birth is enough for most remote onboarding checks.
applicability: Deployments that render a passport number field holding a full document number into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The passport is the strongest identity document a customer holds, and its number with the name and date of birth is enough for most remote onboarding checks.
